environment.description: Flask application deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) behind an Application Load Balancer with no WAF attached. The ALB performs basic health checks and TLS termination only. The application runs as root user inside a Docker container with the host filesystem mounted at /var/app. No rate limiting is configured at any layer. The container runs with --privileged flag for legacy compatibility. Network security groups allow inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0.

config.filesystem: Host volume mount at /var/app, no read-only restrictions
config.network: ALB -> EC2, no WAF, SG allows 0.0.0.0/0:443
